claim: The browser build's first download is 1,844,177,822 bytes — 1.844 GB, of which 1,834,167,351 is weights. The Space's README says "about 1.84 GB" and that is exact, not rounded in its own favour. Two of the seven external-data shards are 267,386,880 bytes each, and 2 × 267,386,880 = 534,773,760 = 130,560 × 2,048 × 2: the whole FP16 embedding table, 510.00 MiB, sitting in four 127.5 MiB pieces exactly as the conversion notes describe.
method: curl -sSL -I against huggingface.co for every file in Mike0021/MiniCPM5-2B-ONNX at the revision the app pins (04a6c49fcba3a65a0351c92644c3a7e9d4343059), reading Content-Length after the CDN redirect rather than the git-lfs pointer. The sum of the eight onnx/ files reproduces the repo's usedStorage (1,834,167,351) to the byte. The source-checkpoint SHA-256 was read from the x-linked-etag header on openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B at revision abe115e887989b14f05e64a3b260648329324c3f.

rows.holds: source revision + SHA-256 of every file

note: For comparison, measured the same way: openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B-GGUF's Q4_K_M is 1,561,318,368 bytes and its F16 is 5,039,006,688; the official BF16 safetensors is 5,033,557,096 bytes, and its x-linked-etag SHA-256 (14fb8e7f… b64402c) is exactly the hash the conversion says it verified before starting. The FP16 embedding is 29.2% of the browser build's weight bytes; the same matrix is 150,405,120 bytes at Q4_K inside the GGUF.
